phone.changelog: v3.4.2: Fixed update checks on older Android WebViews (update banner could silently never appear). Analytics now report the real app version and boot correctly on first launch.

tv.changelog: v3.13.0: One APK for every device — Android TV, Fire TV, phones and tablets. Full catch-up with 20 releases of fixes: dead titles vanish from catalog and search, best-quality direct streams play first, hold LEFT/RIGHT to scan through movies, picture-in-picture, QR phone pairing, smooth remote navigation. Fixed update checks so the banner always appears.

android_tv.changelog: v3.13.0: Fixed update checks (banner could silently never appear on some devices). ClearKey DRM live channels now work on this variant too. Analytics now report the real app version.
